newsitem.title: USA: Diametrics to add to blood analysis system.
newsitem.headline: Diametrics to add to blood analysis system.

text.p: Diametrics Medical Inc said Monday it plans to add blood glucose monitoring to its IRMA SL blood analysis system through an agreement with LifeScan, a Johnson & Johnson company.
The IRMA SL system, used in hospitals, is a hand-held blood analyzer that measures critical blood gas, electrolyte and hematocrit levels immediately at the patient's bedside.

The combined product is expected to be available in some countries by the fourth quarter of 1997. The companies will also collaborate on worldwide sales and marketing efforts including activities at professional meetings and communication efforts to inform, support and educate customers, Diametrics said.
